dedupe_keys.name: upper adige 25 m climatic water balance maps

description: Zenodo publishes annual precipitation, evapotranspiration and climatic water-balance maps for the Upper Adige catchment in South Tyrol, Italy. The provider describes 25 m grids over 1993–2022 and lists separate ZIP archives for the variables under CC BY 4.0, freely accessible. Evapotranspiration uses a Thornthwaite calculation adjusted for land use and topography; precipitation was corrected against runoff in nine watersheds. These maps can define local water-availability forcing for hydropower, irrigation and basin water-supply simulations. Water balance here is precipitation minus evapotranspiration, not an observed river discharge at every cell or a groundwater recharge measurement. The provider reports an overall runoff underestimation in its validation, so users should check basin-scale bias and chosen year before model calibration. It complements data-era5-reanalysis with much finer regional grids, but does not replace hourly atmospheric forcing. No ZIP was downloaded.
